about: compiler/profmd: gzip pprof protobuf decoder, open-addressed SoA lookup tables, CPU/Heap accounting, and Markdown rendering (SELFHOST-TASK-PROFMD-SIZES).

mutants.name: selfhost-profmd-empty-input-rejected
mutants.rule: ParseProfileLimit must fail with EmptyInput on empty input slices.

mutants.name: selfhost-profmd-hash-lookup-probe
mutants.rule: lookupHash must subtract the +1 occupied sentinel offset when returning dense row indices.

mutants.name: selfhost-profmd-cpu-dedup-recursive-cum
mutants.rule: RenderCPUMarkdownFromProfile must attribute cumulative CPU time once per function per sample even across recursive frames.

mutants.name: selfhost-profmd-heap-missing-sample-types
mutants.rule: RenderHeapMarkdownFromProfile must fail MissingHeapSampleTypes when neither alloc_space nor inuse_space exists.
